subject: Quick check-in after today's missed demo
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Linh Tran <linh.tran@fastpay.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@fastpay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in after today's missed demo

Hi Linh / Sara —

Looks like we missed each other for the demo scheduled this morning. I hope this wasn't bad timing — I know end-of-quarter travel can be chaotic. No worries at all.

If the priority on this project shifted, happy to adapt — a couple options on my side:

- 20-minute exec recap (FRAMED: outcomes & costs) — quick for busy leaders
- Full demo + Q&A (30–45 min) — dives into integration details
- Share a 1-page summary + pricing ballpark now if you'd prefer to triage internally first

Attached a short one-pager that summarizes the product and a quick pricing reference (Redwood-One-Pager.pdf).

Can you share whether you'd like us to: (a) reschedule a short briefing, (b) get the materials to Tom in finance, or (c) pause for now and we check back in next month? If rescheduling, here are a few windows I have next week:
- Tue 8/25 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 8/26 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 8/27 08:30–09:00 PT (20-min slot)

Also happy to send a quick poll if that helps.

Thanks — and apologies again if the timing was off.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-One-Pager.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick check-in after today's missed demo

On Fri, Aug 21, 2026 at 9:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Linh / Sara —
> 
> Looks like we missed each other for the demo scheduled this morning. I hope this wasn't bad timing — I know end-of-quarter travel can be chaotic. No worries at all.

Thanks for following up, Sean — and apologies from our side. I ended up on an all-day client offsite in NYC and Sara was pulled into an urgent vendor review.

We have shifted some priorities this week to close a payment rails partner by EOM, so this conversation has slid a little. That said, we are still interested — particularly for a pilot focused on fraud signal enrichment.

Two asks to help me get this back into the calendar with the right people (I'm looping Tom Ellis in finance now):
1) Can you send a very short one-page executive summary highlighting expected latency & unit-cost benefits for a pilot?
2) We need a ballpark pricing range for a 3-month pilot (GPU hours estimate or committed capacity).

If helpful, I can aim for a slot the week after next: Tue Sep 1 or Wed Sep 2 in the afternoon (ET). Either one works better than this week.

Thanks —
Linh Tran
Head of Engineering, FastPay
linh.tran@fastpay.com

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fastpay.com>
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:42:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick check-in after today's missed demo

Grace / Marissa —

Looping you both in. Linh says the team reprioritized this week but still wants to proceed with a pilot. Two quick moves I recommend:

1) Produce a one-page exec summary focused on latency & unit-cost impact (I attached the one-pager we sent; I'll update the numbers into the FastPay MAP doc).
2) Provide a very conservative pricing ballpark for a 3-month pilot (committed capacity). Let's avoid full SOW-level detail until Tom/finance asks.

Plan: I’ll update FastPay-MAP-v2.pdf with a short pricing line and send a 1P + pricing.csv to Linh & Tom. If we can get a 20-min slot the week of 8/31 (their timezone preference is afternoons ET), we can keep momentum.

Notes: keep the ask light — exec summary + ballpark pricing. If they take the bait, we follow with a detailed SOW and pilot scope.

Thanks,
Sean

Subject: Short reschedule poll + one-pager and pilot scope

Hi Linh / Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick note, Linh — I attached an updated 1-page exec summary and a short pilot-scope doc that frames a minimal integration to get useful signals into your fraud stack (pilot-scope-attachment.docx).

To keep this light, can we do a 20-minute exec briefing the week of Aug 31 or the week of Sep 1? I set up a short availability poll — please pick any 15–20 minute window that works for your team: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min?candidate=fastpay-reschedule

Proposed agenda (20 min):
- 5 min: goals & success criteria for pilot
- 8 min: expected performance & integration touchpoints
- 5 min: next steps and ballpark economics

If you'd rather I send the pricing ballpark in-line to Tom first (no meeting), say the word and I’ll forward a simple estimate.

Appreciate the flexibility — and happy to adapt to Tom's timeline.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
